items.title: Ident
items.hook_line: You are watching the WuBu network.

items.title: Station Identification
items.hook_line: WUBUTV / INF:0 / PLEASE STAND BY FOR IDENTIFICATION

items.title: After These Messages
items.hook_line: WE WILL RETURN AFTER THESE MESSAGES

items.title: The Envelope
items.hook_line: The results are inside. They will stay there.

items.title: The Replay
items.hook_line: Let's see that again. There it was.

items.title: The Interview
items.hook_line: Tell us everything. Take your time.

items.title: The Stapler
items.hook_line: A stapler is missing from the newsroom.

items.title: The Traffic Report
items.hook_line: There is no traffic. We checked twice.

items.title: The Penny, Part 2
items.hook_line: The penny has been moved. The investigation continues.

items.title: The Coffee
items.hook_line: The coffee is hot. This is the news.

items.title: The Emergency Broadcast
items.hook_line: This was only a test of your patience.

items.title: The Market Update
items.hook_line: Stocks were seen today near a building.

items.title: The Retraction
items.hook_line: We retract nothing. We stand by the penny.

items.title: The Rerun
items.hook_line: This bumper has aired before. It will air again.

items.title: The Premiere
items.hook_line: Tonight: a premiere. Of a bumper.

items.title: The Marathon
items.hook_line: Hour nine of the bumper marathon.

items.title: The Cliffhanger
items.hook_line: Find out next time. Or don't.

items.title: The Director's Cut
items.hook_line: This is the version I wanted.

items.title: The Commentary
items.hook_line: The director would like you to know this is a bumper.

items.title: The Ratings
items.hook_line: The numbers are in. They are numbers.

items.title: The Award
items.hook_line: We'd like to thank the academy.

items.title: The Ghost Light
items.hook_line: The theater is asleep. The light is awake.

items.title: The Holiday Special
items.hook_line: Happy holidays. From all of us.

items.title: The 3D Episode
items.hook_line: Now in two dimensions, as before.

items.title: The Live Episode
items.hook_line: We are live. We have always been live.

items.title: The Isolation Booth
items.hook_line: The answers are honest in here.

items.title: The Prequel
items.hook_line: Before the bumpers, there were bumpers.

items.title: The Reboot
items.hook_line: Everything is different now. Nothing changed.

items.title: The Skip
items.hook_line: Tap left to hear that again.

items.title: The Final Question
items.hook_line: Final question. There is no final question.

items.title: The Standing Pilot
items.hook_line: It burns so nothing has to wait.

items.title: The Barrier
items.hook_line: The ticket has been paid. The barrier is thinking.

items.title: The Floor Card
items.hook_line: ROOF: AERIALS, WEATHER, THE MAST LOG.

items.title: The Roof Hatch
items.hook_line: The roof is also a room.

items.title: The Corridor Cart
items.hook_line: The mail has arrived at a door.

items.title: The Guy Wire
items.hook_line: The mast is held by this.

items.title: The Long Flash
items.hook_line: The long one is the hour.

items.title: The Kettle, Filled
items.hook_line: no water ever leaves the kettle's spout, mouth, or body

items.title: The Walked Log
items.hook_line: plain letters directly on the fabric with nothing around them

items.title: The Drawer Map
items.hook_line: mouth stays CLOSED through the turn at 6-7s; exactly ONE mouth opening in the entire take

items.title: The Walked Lot
items.hook_line: exactly ONE man appears in the entire take

items.title: The Key That Was Never Given
The Stacked Trays
items.hook_line: exactly two trays in every frame

items.title: The Arranged Magazines
items.hook_line: no scattered magazine in any frame after 6s

items.title: The Snowclone Slip
items.hook_line: The ___ is late. / The ___ is not.

items.title: The Washed Cup
items.hook_line: exactly one cup in every frame

items.title: The Strapped Crate
items.hook_line: [7s] he faces the camera ... [8s-10s] he holds the lens

items.title: The Dated Canister
items.hook_line: the stamped lid in every frame

items.title: The Rip
items.hook_line: This is the news. The rest is paper.

items.title: The Guest Who Is Always About to Arrive
The Paper Town
items.hook_line: The town is on the map.

items.title: The Spare Key
items.hook_line: exactly ONE bare empty hook at 0.5s, zero at 9.5s

items.title: The Last Car
items.hook_line: the car the only vehicle in every frame

items.title: The Roof Door
items.hook_line: one rubber wedge on the roof beside it

items.title: The Fifty-Seven Inches
items.hook_line: This is where the middle goes.

items.title: The Loose Tarp
items.hook_line: exactly one brick in every frame

items.title: The Refused Coin
items.hook_line: exactly one coin in every frame — never two

items.title: The Continuity
items.hook_line: While we wait, the schedule waits too.

items.title: The Current Paper
items.hook_line: the certificate's face reads blank and unlettered to camera in every frame

items.title: The Boiler
items.hook_line: the gauge dial a PLAIN BLANK CREAM DISC ... the needle the ONLY mark on the dial face

items.title: The Lost Drawer
items.hook_line: the desk bare, no text anywhere in the frame

items.title: The Darkroom Tray
items.hook_line: the tray and the blank print visible in the 9.5s frame

items.title: The Vending Restock
items.hook_line: the door STAYS OPEN ... never closing before 6s

items.title: The Platform Line
items.hook_line: the platform edge and the painted line visible in the frame at 6.5s, 7.5s, 8s and 9.5s

items.title: The Unlit Lamp
items.hook_line: The hill goes dark at nine.

items.title: The Unmarked Door
items.hook_line: It does not need a name.

items.title: The Bench Wrench
items.hook_line: We service platforms you cannot use.

items.title: The Locked Gate
items.hook_line: The tower is closed for the night.

items.title: The Straight Stack
items.hook_line: exactly THREE plates total in the entire take — one single stack, no second stack

items.title: The Smoked Rack
items.hook_line: The smoke will do the rest.

items.title: The Lit Panel
items.hook_line: no bed louder than -25 dBFS before the 4s flip, ever

items.title: The Covered Statue
items.hook_line: The statue was here all along.

items.title: The Held Sheet
items.hook_line: The wires are still in it.

items.title: The Two Chandlers
items.hook_line: Wax for the church. Tallow for the house.
